items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this actively exploited flaw.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: A regularly scheduled security update resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: CosmicSting attack: Critical bug allowing file reading and RCE
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows bad actors to read sensitive files like encryption keys and, when combined with CVE-2024-2961, can lead to remote code execution and backdoor installation. Sansec observed mass exploitation of this flaw.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Elevated Access
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch customer sessions and escalate privileges. This vulnerability has been actively exploited in the wild and was added to the CISA KEV.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security bulletin addresses critical and important vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. It includes fixes for issues like unauthenticated customer account takeover.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce B2B leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affects Adobe Commerce B2B and could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass (unauthenticated)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. This vulnerability requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution (admin privileges)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass (admin privileges)
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation (admin privileges)
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.
